description:
Si-an, a man seemingly lacking nothing—his career, family background, even his looks. Into this seemingly flawless life, a baby suddenly appears?

A newborn baby, handed over by his ex-girlfriend who suddenly reappeared, claiming it was his. Suddenly thrust into fatherhood, Si-an frantically searches for a babysitter. But the babysitter who arrives, Geon-hyeok, is somehow a man of enormous stature and an impressive(?) face! The reluctant cohabitation with this burly male babysitter gradually takes a peculiar turn as their time together accumulates…!

A sweet family romance between parenting novice Level 0 Si-an and parenting master Level 99 Geon-hyeok.
